problem_type: Recovered read-only CI Git transport failures escape into persistent failure annotations
symptom: Quality Gate run 45264322182 failed annotation hygiene despite successful Validation Scope job 138007074731 with one failure annotation.
direct_cause: Checkout registers a problem matcher for raw Git fatal/error lines before its retrying fetch. Attempt 1 logged the connection error as a failure, waited 15 seconds, and ran the same full-history fetch again. The retry succeeded and the classifier read 10 changed files. The classifier independently converted unexpected exceptions into successful full-profile outputs.
class_root: The scope job lacked an outcome boundary that keeps per-attempt diagnostics private and only publishes a profile after acquiring and comparing the requested commits.
affected_population: Quality Gate scope for main pushes, pull requests, merge queue, and manual runs
entry_points: Quality Gate jobs.scope checkout and profile steps

external_sources.purpose: Git fetch receives retry wrapping at the action execution boundary.
The Git matcher promotes raw fatal/error output to annotations before the checkout result is known.
Explicit refspec list and depth limiting.
Two-commit diff compares endpoint trees without walking ancestors.
The pinned runner image family provides Git and Node before checkout.

invariants: Valid nonzero base and head are available locally before the profile is emitted.
Recovered fetch attempts do not emit failure annotations.
Permanent fetch failure, retry exhaustion, and classifier exceptions fail the job.

door_reduction.why_not: The classifier reads and computes the profile; the output writer publishes the result to the separate Actions outputs interface. The second publication call in the error branch is removed.

generality_proof: Event-derived SHA pairs follow the same checkout path for push, PR and merge queue. Captured child output cannot create annotations while retry is pending. No-baseline inputs follow explicit policy; failed diff of a supplied range never yields outputs.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Acquire the exact event commits before any checked-out code executes and report the terminal fetch result.
Classify the local comparison and propagate failures.
Classify read-only Git fetch failures. A workflow test locks the cold-start copy and retry defaults to this owner.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: One job-level SHA selection and one checkout step cover these triggers.
The same checkout acquires head only and the classifier retains manual full validation.
Annotation retrieval is already retried via fetchWithRetry; the checker treats every failure annotation as evidence.
Delivery fetches wrap the command in retryTransient. The common classifier dispatches Git fetch stderr to isTransientGitFetchError.

recurrence.reason: A runner transport failure can occur on any event, and the action can annotate a recovered attempt on each run.
same_class_scan: rg actions/checkout .github/workflows identified repo checkout paths. Scope only needs two endpoint snapshots; other full-history action callers are outside this repair.
rg select-quality-gate-profile scripts .github traced the sole workflow caller and the output writer test.
Reviewed #1158 and the existing annotation fetch retry boundary.
eng-metrics --candidates found shared workflow files but no prior contract for annotations emitted by a recovered Git fetch.

prevention.invariant: Scope publishes successful checkout only after retrieving its endpoint commits, without forwarding child output from failed attempts.
prevention.failure_mode: Terminal fetch or diff errors exit nonzero and no profile is published.
prevention.strategy: Replace the scope action with an exact-SHA shallow fetch and captured retries; remove the classifier catch that reports success on unexpected errors.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the full-history scope checkout action and the success exit for classifier exceptions.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Scope removes the checkout action dependency and uses the runner-provided Git CLI. Other jobs keep their existing checkout behavior.

migration: No persisted user data or required check names change.
residual_risks: Hosted Actions replay is unverified before push. Recheck subsequent main runs for zero failure annotations on a recovered scope fetch and a successful exact-SHA receipt; reopen on recurrence.
